profile.name: Pradeep Chauhan
profile.tagline: I build fast, scalable Angular products that people actually enjoy using.
profile.summary: Front-End Developer with 5+ years of experience building scalable, high-performance Single Page Applications using Angular (v12+), TypeScript and JavaScript (ES6+). Expert in RxJS, REST API integration, reusable component architecture and responsive, cross-browser UI development — with a track record of lifting application performance by up to 30% through lazy loading and code optimisation.

stats.label: Faster load times

stats.label: Industry domains

services.title: Angular Application Architecture
services.copy: Modular, lazy-loaded Angular apps built on reusable component libraries, typed services and route guards — structured so new features land in days, not weeks.

services.title: Reactive State with RxJS
services.copy: Predictable async data flows using switchMap, mergeMap and debounceTime — live dashboards, typeahead search and real-time transactions without race conditions.

services.title: Performance Engineering
services.copy: Change-detection tuning, code splitting and bundle optimisation that has cut initial load times by 20-30% on enterprise-scale applications.

services.title: Responsive & Accessible UI
services.copy: Pixel-accurate, cross-browser interfaces from a designer handoff — mobile-first, WCAG-aware, and consistent from 320px to ultrawide.

points: Developed scalable Angular applications using reusable components and modular architecture, reducing development time for new features.
Improved application performance by 30% through lazy loading, code splitting and code optimisation.

Collaborated with UI/UX teams to build responsive, accessible (WCAG-aware) interfaces across web and mobile.
Mentored 3+ junior developers and ran regular code reviews to enforce clean-code standards.

keyProject.title: Banking Web & Mobile Application
points: Built a secure, scalable banking web and mobile app with role-based access control (RBAC).
Implemented real-time transactions and account management via REST API integration.
Optimised performance using lazy loading, code splitting and RxJS-based state management.
Built dynamic Angular/TypeScript web applications, reducing initial load time by 20%.
Integrated RESTful APIs and third-party services; used RxJS for efficient reactive state management.
Optimised application performance through lazy loading and refactoring, improving page speed by 30%.
Participated in Agile/Scrum ceremonies — sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives — alongside UX/UI designers.

projects.title: Banking Web & Mobile App
projects.summary: A secure banking platform delivered as a single Angular codebase for web and an Ionic Angular build for mobile, covering onboarding, accounts and real-time transactions.
highlights: Role-based access control (RBAC) enforced through route guards and typed permission services
Real-time transaction and account management over REST APIs with resilient error handling
Lazy-loaded feature modules plus RxJS state streams kept the bundle lean as scope grew

projects.title: Logistics ERP System
projects.summary: Enterprise ERP modules for shipment tracking, with live operational dashboards and heavy data-entry workflows used daily by logistics teams.
highlights: Real-time shipment dashboards driven by RxJS streams and polling with backoff
Complex reactive forms with cross-field custom validators and dynamic form arrays
Large-dataset tables rendered smoothly through virtualisation and change-detection tuning

projects.title: Real Estate Web Application
projects.summary: A responsive property listing and discovery experience with faceted search, map-adjacent browsing and a mobile-first layout.
highlights: Debounced, filter-aware property search that stayed responsive on slow networks
Reusable Tailwind + Bootstrap component set for cards, filters and detail pages
Measurably smoother navigation and a clearer path from listing to enquiry

projects.title: Google Search UI Clone
projects.summary: A hand-built, pixel-accurate recreation of the Google search interface — a deliberate exercise in typography, spacing and cross-browser fidelity.
highlights: Matched spacing, type scale and interaction states against the reference UI
Written in vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript with no framework or UI kit
Verified across Chrome, Firefox and Edge at every breakpoint

projects.title: This Portfolio
projects.summary: The site you are reading — a zoneless Angular 22 application built on signals, standalone components and custom directives, with every animation hand-written in CSS and the Web APIs.
highlights: Signal-driven state with zoneless change detection — no zone.js in the bundle
Custom directives for scroll reveal, 3D pointer tilt, magnetic hover and count-up
Canvas particle field, animated aurora mesh and a fully honoured prefers-reduced-motion
